sentences.text: Most nautical charts use the Mercator projection.
Its big advantage is that a straight line on the chart is a rhumb line, a line of constant direction, so you can lay a course with parallel rulers and steer it.
The latitude scale gets longer as you move away from the equator, so on a small-scale chart a nautical mile measured near the top is longer than one measured near the bottom.
That’s why you always measure distance on the part of the latitude scale beside where you’re working.
